text:
alex: Hey infra — onboarding for tenant 'NimbleAI' needs GPU capacity in eu-south-1 and ap-east-1. We need p5 + g5 (and small p4d) headroom, plus ENI/vCPU increases for the VPCs. Can someone start quota requests?

maria: I can take the quota forms. Do we have exact counts per instance type and account IDs? AWS will want specific numbers per instance family and region.

alex: Initial ask from product/solutions:
- eu-south-1 (account 987654321098): p5.48xlarge x4, g5.48xlarge x8, p4d.24xlarge x1
- ap-east-1 (account 876543210987): g5.12xlarge x6
Also need EC2-VCPU quota bumped to ~6400 and ENI quota to support ~5000 concurrent IPs for pod density. This is for a pilot but they want runway.

chen: That’s a big ask. Can we stage it? Maybe request a conservative initial quota and then request increases after pilot runs. ENI/vCPU increases are usually straightforward but large jumps can trigger capacity checks.

maria: Sequencing idea: request p5/g5 headroom first in eu-south-1, ask for p4d as a follow-up (AWS often needs DC confirmation). Put rationale in the support case: "tenant onboarding, deterministic latency SLOs, GPU families for heterogenous workloads".

sam: I raised an Enterprise support case: Case #12457890. Subject: "Quota increase request for p5/p4d/g5 + EC2-VCPU and ENI in eu-south-1 & ap-east-1 for Redwood tenant onboarding". TAM assigned.

infra-bot: Cost estimate (auto): if fully provisioned monthly approx $270k. Suggest canary with 2 p5 + 2 g5 first to validate runtime and autoscaler.

alex: Good call on canary. Adding account numbers to the case: eu acct 987654321098, apac acct 876543210987. Maria — please add those to the PR.

maria: Done. PR: /infra/quota-requests.md updated with case link and account IDs. Also added the cost note and smoke test checklist.

alex: For reference, here's how I check current quotas via CLI when triaging:```bash
aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-34B43A08
# and for vCPU: aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-F678F1CE
```

chen: Also remember AZ distribution — ask for spread across 3 AZs if possible to avoid single-AZ capacity issues. For ENIs, consider using instance types with higher ENI-per-instance to reduce total ENI need.

alex: Networking note: we also need intra-VPC high-throughput allowed (ENA) and NAT capacity. Network team — can you confirm NAT/gateway sizing and any SG rules? @marco

marco: I'll take networking. For NAT, recommend using VPC endpoints for S3/ECR to cut NAT cost, and scale NAT gateways with auto scaling patterns. For SGs: open intra-VPC on 10.0.0.0/16 for cluster control plane ports and 9000-9010 for runtime telemetry. ENA speed requirement is supported by p5/g5 families — we just need to ensure the AMIs enable ENA.

sam: AWS updated case: eu-south-1 p5 quota approved to 6, g5 approved to 12, p4d pending capacity check. EC2-VCPU increase approved to 5600, ENI quota approved to 6000. Updated in case #12457890 — TAM added notes about availability and recommended phasing. Screenshots attached to PR.

alex: That’s better than expected. Who will apply terraform once quotas exist? I can do canary infra but want chen to own the full module rollout.

chen: I’ll create a new terraform module branch: infra/gpu-clusters/nimbleai. I’ll wire the AMI, instance profiles, and autoscaler configs. Alex — can you share the runtime smoke tests and perf targets?

alex: Yep — I’ll post the smoke test runbook here once I finish the basic checks (health, latency p95 < 120ms, snapshot of token cost).

maria: Scheduling note: propose a maintenance window Friday 03:00-05:00 UTC for canary spin-up to avoid traffic spikes. If anyone objects speak now.

alex: Works for me. I’ll be on call for the run. :thumbsup:

sam: Closing loop — keep the case open until p4d is either approved or we have confirmed capacity alternatives. I’ll update the PR with the final case log.

alex: Thanks all — will update this thread with smoke test results and terraform PR link.
